title: Why do beginner gains slow down? 📉
caption:
Your first weeks of strength come mostly from your nervous system learning the lift. Real muscle growth shows up within weeks too, but the easy jumps fade as you get closer to your limit. How long have you been lifting? 👇

Muscle Building, Part 10
first_comment: Year 1: +20 kg on the bench. Year 5: +2.5 kg. Accurate? 😅
sources: Moritani T, deVries HA. Neural factors versus hypertrophy in the time course of muscle strength gain. Am J Phys Med 1979;58:115-130

Seynnes OR, de Boer M, Narici MV. Early skeletal muscle hypertrophy and architectural changes in response to high-intensity resistance training. J Appl Physiol 2007;102:368-373 (growth measurable at about 3 weeks)
Folland JP, Williams AG. The adaptations to strength training: morphological and neurological contributions to increased strength. Sports Med 2007;37:145-168
